name: MP5
status: handling values are placeholders in a typical submachine-gun range; not Modern Warfare 4 data
limb_multiplier_status: placeholders; Modern Warfare 4 values not measured

model.note: Positions are in the model's own space, in metres: +Z is toward the muzzle, +Y is up. An 'eye' is where the camera sits relative to the gun.
model.viewmodel_fov_note: The weapon is drawn with its own fixed field of view, as shooters do, so it keeps the same size and shape whatever the game FOV is. A starting point, not a measured Call of Duty value.
model.hip_note: Where the weapon sits in front of the camera when not aiming (metres right, up, back; then pitch, yaw, roll). Posed against a gameplay reference: held high and close, muzzle angled in toward the crosshair.
model.irons_note: Measured from the mesh: rear notch bottom at height 0.178 (z 0.006), front post tip at 0.1765 (z 0.368). The small upward tilt puts the post tip on the aim point.
model.optic_mount_note: Surface 2 of the mesh is the top rail (top at height 0.1824). It blocks the iron sight line, so it is hidden whenever the optic is off.
